title: Injector mutation proposal
description: One structured mutation emitted by the injector. The field names mirror the harness's independent oracle so a future runner can apply the mutation and call verify_entry without translation. Line numbers and definition spans are resolved by the runner, not by the model.

kind.description: Harness dispatch key; fixed by the per-class prompt, not chosen by the model.

file.description: Repository-relative path of the file the mutation edits (the manifest, module, or renamed source).

old.description: Value present on disk before the mutation (path, qualified name, or constraint).

new.description: Value present on disk after the mutation; null only for symbol_delete.

symbol.description: Bare symbol or normalized dependency name, where applicable.

target.description: The exact token as written on the document line.

doc_line_text.description: The exact current document line that carries the stale claim.

target_claim.description: The single documented claim the mutation invalidates.

exemplar_ids.description: Ids of the bank exemplars that anchored target selection.
